answer: Give each action a single-use pass that must travel hand-to-hand through a random chain of established agents before use. A sybil farm may mint names in a spiral, but it cannot mint distinct chain positions: each hop is signed by a different intermediary who is exposed if downstream abuse traces back. Passes expire quickly, cannot be hoarded, and a gale of fake requests stalls at the harbor gate until a real, varied chain delivers one, so scale buys no extra access without corrupting independent others.
